domain_and_error_parity.defaults: unspecified inputs: F3 = T-07 (TPMC) at atm 200 mean; F2 = C-01
domain_and_error_parity.message_key_rule: Python ValueError messages are classified with the substrings of PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_INTAKE_TPMC_PY-V1 (intake ROM extrapolation -> OUT_OF_BOUNDS, all mass fractions are zero -> ALL_ZERO, mass fractions must be finite and >= 0 -> FRACTION_INVALID); ZeroDivisionError -> PASSIVE_ZERO. Rust messages start with the key followed by ': '
domain_and_error_parity.mapping_rule: ValueError and ZeroDivisionError -> AbepError::OutOfDomain (status OUT_OF_DOMAIN) with the registered message key; no other Python exception is raised by the scored inputs. No Rust path returns a value where Python fails or fails where Python returns, except the documented divergences (CLAUDE.md rule 3)

documented_divergence.statement: compress passive_override that is not finite and > 0: the reference treats 0.0 as 'not given' (truthiness of `passive_override if passive_override else ...`) and computes the passive ratio, uses a negative value as given, and propagates NaN; Rust takes Option<f64>, None = computed, and refuses Some(x) unless x is finite and > 0 (OutOfDomain PASSIVE_OVERRIDE_INVALID)
documented_divergence.disposition: outside the comparison set; no silent substitution in Rust

documented_divergence.statement: compress anode_conductance_m3_s that is not finite and > 0: the reference treats 0.0 as unset (truthiness) and uses negative values (negative pressure); Rust takes Option<f64> and refuses Some(c) unless c is finite and > 0 (OutOfDomain CONDUCTANCE_INVALID)
unknown scattering in the TPMC branch: same failure class, different key and stage (DE-04)
documented_divergence.disposition: scored as DE-04 with the registered key mapping

documented_divergence.statement: the Rust collection receives the frozen surfaces (both scattering tables, m_mean_build_kg explicit) as an argument; the reference loads them lazily into the module cache _SURF_CACHE keyed by scattering, with m_mean_build from frozen_surface_build_atmosphere()
documented_divergence.disposition: interface difference only; the harness passes the reference m_mean_build value

documented_divergence.statement: the reference reads the frozen CSV with pandas' default float converter (17 cells 1 ulp off correctly rounded, see PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_INTAKE_TPMC_PY-V1 DIV-05); Rust parses correctly rounded
documented_divergence.disposition: inside the comparison set, within the TPMC-branch tolerance

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable meets its tolerance class
decision_rules.entry_point_result: PARITY_PASS or PARITY_FAIL per entry point F1..F3: PARITY_PASS iff all its per-test, invariant, conservation, domain / error and schema checks pass
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every entry point is PARITY_PASS, every required invariant holds, and every reference file and pinned input matches its registered sha256; otherwise NOT_ADMITTED (or REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED / INPUT_MISMATCH / NOT_RUN_RUST_UNAVAILABLE)
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for intake.collection / compress / passive_compression (within the registered domain); new production results for them come from Rust and carry implementation = rust, rust_commit and this contract id. It is NOT physics validation; the parametric eta_c / C_D / compressor-power coefficients keep their committed status
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to retained selected-architecture physics (RM-R20)
